name: Taskiem for you
title: Taskiem for you: how to deal with a business on Taskiem as a customer
blurb: A day with Tobi Adewale in Lagos: signing up with a phone number, finding a business, asking it a question, ordering and paying, following the order, booking a service, sharing a business with his mother, starting a family group, ordering lunch together at the office, and keeping it all safe. Taskiem sits beside WhatsApp and Telegram; it is for dealing with a business, not a replacement for your other chats. Episode 0 shows the whole day; Episodes 1 to 10 teach each part.
card_sub: Find, ask, order, pay and follow: one day with Tobi in Lagos.
cta: Talk to a business on Taskiem
cta_sub: Find a business, ask, order and pay, beside the chats you already have.
